source._build_note: CORE build only (default `make`, SUBDIRS=src; NOT BUILD_WITH_MODULES=yes -- the Query Engine modules require a network git clone + Rust and are excluded). builder_image is ubuntu:24.04, the same distro as the runtime base (Ubuntu 24.04, gcc 13, glibc 2.39): build-essential (gcc/g++/make/libc6-dev), pkg-config and libssl-dev (for BUILD_TLS=yes) are vendored as build debs and dpkg-installed in the --network=none offline stage, so redis-server links against the same libssl3t64 the runtime installs. ALL of redis's native dependencies (jemalloc 5.3.0, lua 5.1, hiredis, hdr_histogram, fpconv, linenoise, tre, xxhash) are committed UNDER deps/ as source and compiled by the deps/Makefile that `make` invokes -> NO dependency download, the compile is fully offline-capable. dep_bumps does NOT apply to C (no module graph); the CVE-remediation lever here is the FRESH base + the debvendor dist-upgrade of libssl3t64/libc6 (Phase 2). `make install PREFIX=/usr/local` lays down redis-server + redis-cli + redis-benchmark and symlinks redis-check-rdb/redis-check-aof/redis-sentinel into PREFIX/bin. LIVE-VERIFIED: 14MB static-ish ELF redis-server (jemalloc-5.3.0), `Redis server v=8.8.0`, zero-network compile.
source.source_date_epoch_provenance: the time release 8.10.3-CE-ubuntu24.04-r4 was cut (2026-11-20T07:53:39Z), by scripts/retarget.py --rev-bump: ReadyStack dates an image by when its release was packaged (owner 2026-11-10), recorded here once and used by every rebuild of the release; it builds upstream commit 1a2574ce1551, dated 2026-10-26T11:37:04Z (source.commit_epoch).

binaries_from_source.name: redis-server
binaries_from_source._note: The daemon. `redis-server --version` -> `Redis server v=8.8.0 sha=... malloc=jemalloc-5.3.0 bits=64 build=...` (verified live). Links libssl.so.3/libcrypto.so.3 when BUILD_TLS=yes (runtime base must ship libssl.so.3: Ubuntu 24.04's libssl3t64). redis-check-rdb / redis-check-aof / redis-sentinel are install-time symlinks to this same binary.

binaries_from_source.name: redis-cli
binaries_from_source._note: REQUIRED in the runtime image -- it IS the health check, the seed driver, and the doc-probe client (Redis has no HTTP). `redis-cli --version` -> `redis-cli 8.8.0`.
